label: Diagram 24
caption: Diagram 24 Constructional hearth suitable for a solid fuel appliance (including open fires)
description:
The drawing, titled "Diagram 24 Constructional hearth suitable for a solid fuel appliance (including open fires)", shows two grey shapes drawn in plan.

On the left, labelled "(a) Fireplace recess" and grouped under the word "Plan", is a grey hearth drawn against a wall line at the top. The middle of this wall line has a rectangular recess, into which the central part of the hearth fits, so that the hearth outline is stepped; the wider lower part of the hearth projects forward from the wall line. A horizontal double-headed arrow at the top is labelled "At least 150mm", spanning the width of this recess (the central part of the hearth that fits into it). A vertical double-headed arrow on the left, labelled "Projection at least 500mm from jamb", measures the hearth's projection beyond the wall line.

On the right, labelled "(b) Free standing", is a separate grey square. A horizontal double-headed arrow above it reads "At least 840mm", and a vertical double-headed arrow to its right also reads "At least 840mm".

The bottom row of text reads, from left to right: "Plan", "(a) Fireplace recess", "(b) Free standing".
